name: Knight's Maintenance Kit

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Knights of Lastwall

text: This set of gear contains a repair kit, cloth rolls for storing or covering equipment, and specialized mixtures developed by the Knights of Lastwall to clean and treat armaments for continued use. This kit gives you a +1 item bonus to checks to Repair weapons, shields, and armor using the Crafting skill, and you restore an additional 5 Hit Points when you successfully Repair such items using it.
